blocks.text: OFTEN. BUT IN 1947, HE IS IN NEW YORK, AT THE UN. AND IF YOU BELIEVE HIM, HE SWINGS A VOTE THERE.
COHEN PRODUCES AN OLD LETTER IN WHICH SUN YAT-SEN SUPPORTED ZIONISM. HE PUTS IT UNDER THE NOSE OF THE HEAD OF THE CHINESE DELEGATION.
THAT'S HIS|BIOGRAPHER'S VERSION.|HISTORIANS ARE|STILL ARGUING|ABOUT IT.
LET'S SAY HE WAS IN THE ROOM.
